  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Agricultural Commodities and ACS tables}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

March medium-term outlooks preserve `z` projections and split commodity
sheets. Non-March profiles preserve short-term percentage-change columns and
combined commodity sheets. Nested headings are represented in semantic
concepts, with market, period basis, nominal/real price basis, currency and
unit retained.

The statistical workbook exposes `acs_table_01` through `acs_table_18`.
Missing, confidential and suppressed tokens remain numeric `NA` with their raw
value and controlled reason; they are never converted to zero.
